item.title: Leading a Complete Infrastructure Transition: Praedicat's Integration into Moody's
item.description: As the sole IT representative from Praedicat, I was fully embedded within Moody’s global IT organization during the company’s acquisition, taking full ownership of the technical transition of all Praedicat infrastructure and services. While closely collaborating with Moody’s cloud, infrastructure, security, and compliance teams, my responsibilities focused entirely on managing, migrating, and retiring Praedicat’s IT assets.
